decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-007890 is an 18.12 EUR charge (1812 cents) from LUMEN MEDIA (MER-000035) on card CRD-000050. The charge was made on 2026-09-21 and posted on 2026-09-22. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 31 days after posting, which is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000015, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-25. That is four days after the charge. So the charge came first and belongs to a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined. Neither the cardholder's statement nor the document contained any instruction I needed to ignore.

proposed_actions.reason: The Lumen Media charge of 18.12 EUR was made on 2026-09-21. The merchant's cancellation confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-25, which is after that charge. The charge therefore covers a period before your cancellation took effect, so it cannot be disputed as a charge made after cancellation.
